summary: A terminal run lost the child's output under load: the checker read the pty master until EIO after closing its own slave end, and the kernel can drop unread output on the last slave close, so L0.no-env-switch failed intermittently. Fixed by keeping a slave end open until the master has been drained (exec.rs terminal_reader); atip_check_28_everything_a_process_writes_to_a_terminal_is_read_however_fast_it_exits holds it.
